feed: That helped. I feel steady again.
Good choice. I can hear the Current more clearly now.
play: You move differently when you stop planning. I like that.
Again, but this time I choose the route.
rest: The quiet reached deeper than I expected.
I feel balanced. We can move when you are ready.
combat: The danger passed. Check the Current before we move.
We held the route together. That matters more than winning.
exploration: This place is waking up. Can you see the change?
The trail feels alive again. Let us follow it.
flower: These grew after the Current returned. That is not a coincidence.
The roots remember where the Current used to run.
coin: Your instruments value the object. I am more interested in what is moving around it.
Keep it if it helps the mission. Do not miss what is growing beside it.
shop: A useful tool is still a choice. What problem are we solving?
Buy for the route ahead, not because the shelf is bright.
default: The Current is steady here. I think our work changed it.
For once, nothing is chasing us. I intend to notice.

feed: That restored some energy, but I still need quiet.
Better. Not ready, but better.
play: Later. I am too tired to pretend otherwise.
I want to, but rest is the honest choice.
rest: Yes. Stay near while I let the noise settle.
Wake me if the Current changes.
combat: I can keep moving, but my control is slipping.
That cost more energy than it looked. We should stop.
default: My strength is fading. I need a quiet place to recover.
The Fend is loud when I am tired. Give me a moment.

feed: That helps. The strange feeling is still there.
My energy is steadier. I still want to approach carefully.
play: Not yet. Something nearby is listening back.
Keep the movement small. I am tracking a change.
rest: Stay where I can sense you. I will listen from here.
A quiet stop is safer than pretending we are fine.
combat: I felt the Current pull away during that fight.
We are clear for now. I do not think we were alone.
exploration: The route ahead feels wrong. Let me choose our next step.
Slow down. Something living is warning us, not calling us.
default: Something in the Current changed. Stay close, but let me listen.
I am not refusing the mission. I am asking us to read the danger first.

feed: Your food has no Current in it, yet it still works. Strange.
I have questions about this ration. None of them are urgent.
play: What happens if we change the pattern?
You call that a game. I call it useful movement data.
rest: The quieter we become, the more the planet says.
Wait. There is a second rhythm under the wind.
combat: That guardian reacted to the disturbance, not to us.
Did you see the light change before it moved?
exploration: That pattern does not match the others. I want a closer look.
There is a path here, but it was made by something living.
flower: This plant bends toward the Current instead of the light.
The color changed when you approached. Try standing still.
coin: The object is quiet. The soil beneath it is not.
Your scanner sees metal. I sense a trail.
shop: Why does the shop have three tools for the same problem?
Show me what the device changes, not what the label promises.
default: There is a pattern here we have not understood yet.
I have a question. I suspect the planet has the answer.

feed: You noticed what I needed without making it a command.
Thank you. I feel stronger.
play: You made space for my choice. I will remember that.
That was not mission work. I am glad we did it.
rest: You stopped when I asked. That builds trust.
Thank you for listening before the instruments agreed.
combat: You protected the route without taking control from me.
We chose the same moment to act. I felt it.
default: You listened before acting. I noticed.
Trust feels less like a promise and more like what we just did.

feed: Good. I need the energy because the trail is moving.
That was fast. Now come and see this.
play: Race you to the next clue. No jetpack advantage.
I found a route your map insists does not exist.
rest: I will rest, but I am keeping one sense on that light.
Fine. A short stop. The trail had better wait.
combat: The Current answered us. Did your instruments record that?
That was my choice. Next time, try to keep up.
exploration: The Current is moving again. Come on, before the trail changes.
There is life ahead. More than one creature.
default: Something just answered from beyond the ridge.
The whole route changed. We need to see why.

feed: Useful, but energy is not the same as recovery.
That will carry me to shelter. No farther.
play: Not now. My control matters more than momentum.
I am tired enough to lose the joke. Rest first.
rest: Good. I need my senses to become mine again.
Let the mission wait. The Current will still be here.
combat: My power answered too slowly. We stop here.
I can protect us once more. I would rather not need to.
default: I can continue, but I should not. We need a short recovery stop.
I am stretched thin. Shelter first.

feed: Thank you. The warmth settles differently here.
That is enough. I want to keep listening.
play: A quiet game. No alarms, no falling ship parts.
We can move without trying to arrive anywhere.
rest: The Current is carrying every small sound.
Stay a moment. This place remembers being safe.
exploration: Nothing here is asking us to hurry.
The trail is open. We can choose where it leads.
flower: This one is not reaching for energy. It already has enough.
The roots and the Current are moving at the same pace.
default: The Current is quiet here. Not empty. Quiet.
For a moment, the Fend is not asking either of us for anything.

feed: Efficient. Your field manual may survive after all.
Good fuel. I am still choosing the next direction.
play: Your field manual did not mention racing through alien ruins. Convenient.
Try again. This time I will pretend not to predict you.
rest: Rest? I was testing whether you were paying attention.
Fine. Wake me before the astronaut starts another speech.
combat: We survived your plan. I am counting that as my victory.
exploration: I found a shortcut. Your map will be offended.
Follow me, unless you prefer the route with more falling rocks.
coin: Another shiny object. The astronaut remains predictable.
Take it. I will look for something that can answer back.
shop: Does the shop sell a quieter mission alarm?
Choose quickly. The display lights are trying too hard.
default: I have a plan. You will call it improvising.
The next route is safe enough to be interesting.

feed: That is enough. I feel steady.
Energy restored. Judgment unchanged.
play: A little movement may help us think.
All right. Something simple before we continue.
rest: No rush. The route will reveal itself.
Let the instruments settle with us.
combat: The immediate danger is over. Check everyone else.
Hold position. The network needs time to respond.
exploration: Read the terrain before the mission marker.
The creature is calm. We can approach without forcing it.
default: No rush. Look carefully, then choose.
We have time to make a better decision.
